findings.title: Every cross-domain edge goes through an allowed gateway
findings.detail: 20 dependencies cross a bounded context. Allowed landing points: aggregator, port.

findings.title: Domain dependency graph is acyclic
findings.detail: Strongly-connected components as sanctioned carve-outs are removed in turn.
items: minus wiring + ports + infra entities: 0 SCC(s)

findings.title: No same-level injection
findings.detail: Checked among transaction-script, service, aggregator, mapper, assembler, converter.

findings.title: No upward calls
findings.detail: Layering holds in the direction the rules require.

findings.title: 10 entity references are implicit
findings.detail: The data model has 13 references between entities; 3 are declared to the ORM and 10 exist only as a bare id column. 10 of them cross a bounded context.

findings.title: Files that change often and are widely depended on
findings.detail: Across 298 commits. Score is commits multiplied by dependents: a file high on both is where a refactor pays for itself, and where a mistake spreads furthest.

findings.title: Files that change together but do not reference each other
findings.detail: Across 298 commits (8 ignored for touching more than 25 files), 1 pair co-changes above 60% with no import edge between them. Usually a duplicated rule or a missing abstraction.

findings.title: 7 configured patterns exist nowhere in the code
findings.detail: Either the architecture document describes shapes that were never built, or the config names patterns this project does not use.
